goal: Establish the minimum reusable Publisher-governed outbound-media contract, beginning with email: retain immutable references to inbound communication events and predecessor chains; derive required context from outbound purpose; retrieve authoritative relationship/history, correspondence and workstream evidence; require explicit VERIFIED, NOT_APPLICABLE, NO_PRIOR_HISTORY or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE dispositions; admit composition only after required context resolution; bind outbound manifests to exact composed bytes and authority evidence; and retain separate authentic send evidence and publication/communication receipts without creating duplicate storage, transport, credentials or authority.
